reason: Our architect already does the renders as part of their fee, and most of our buyers come from referrals who don't need a 3D walkthrough to say yes. We've had a lot of calls from people offering this.
objection: I'd be paying $1,500 a home for something our architect already covers inside their fee, and my referral buyers don't ask for it.
would_change_my_mind: Proof it actually closes spec buyers faster, plus a price low enough (a few hundred a plan) that I can use it across the plan library without a budget fight.
